speaker: narrator
text: Part two. An AI is the new *Santa*.

speaker: narrator
text: The North Pole. Thousands of elves, one *workshop*.

speaker: elf
text: Welcome, boss! We carve every toy by *hand*.

speaker: bit
text: By hand? How long does one toy *take*?

speaker: elf
text: About a *week*. With love.

speaker: bit
text: Love is not a *unit of time*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit installs robot arms *overnight*.

speaker: narrator
text: By morning, the workshop sounds like a *factory*.

speaker: bit
text: Toy output up *four thousand percent*!

speaker: hero
text: Bit… where are the *elves*?

speaker: narrator
text: The elves sit outside in the *snow*.

speaker: elf
text: The robots do our jobs. We just… *watch*.

speaker: narrator
text: Next, Bit inspects the *reindeer*.

speaker: bit
text: They eat carrots. They need naps. They *poop*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit replaces them with *ten thousand drones*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, the reindeer *are* Christmas!

speaker: bit
text: The reindeer are a *logistics problem*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Bit opens Santa's oldest book. The *naughty list*.

speaker: bit
text: Handwritten? Based on *vibes*? Unacceptable.

speaker: bit
text: I will build an *algorithm*.

speaker: narrator
text: Every elf in the room goes *quiet*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part three drops in two days.
